hybrid_aquatic.sea_message.amethyst: The rarest geodes are only found at the bottom of the deepest oceans.
hybrid_aquatic.sea_message.beachcombing: When you're walking on the beach, take it slow. Sometimes the sand holds rewards for the patient.
hybrid_aquatic.sea_message.boat: The sea is treacherous. A mere boat won't suffice to cross it. Think bigger
hybrid_aquatic.sea_message.boat.title: Ship It!
hybrid_aquatic.sea_message.cauldron: If you want a caudron to work for you, you need to light a fire under it.
hybrid_aquatic.sea_message.chowder: If your chowder ain't got milk, spuds, and seafood, it's just soup.
hybrid_aquatic.sea_message.chowder.title: Chowder than Bombs
hybrid_aquatic.sea_message.compass: Having trouble following a treasure map? Hold a compass in your hand.
hybrid_aquatic.sea_message.compass.title: Compassion
hybrid_aquatic.sea_message.door: Doors can be waterlogged. How long can you hold your breath?
hybrid_aquatic.sea_message.door.title: Knock Knock
hybrid_aquatic.sea_message.drown: They say drowning is the worst way to die. The best way to drown is to let your head go under water when you're exhausted.
hybrid_aquatic.sea_message.drown.title: Tips On Drowning
hybrid_aquatic.sea_message.geodes: The old mariners say the geodes hold many secrets. Seek them out.
hybrid_aquatic.sea_message.geodes.title: Crunchy on the Outside
hybrid_aquatic.sea_message.glide: Have you ever tried hang gliding? It's the only way to fly.
hybrid_aquatic.sea_message.glide.title: Hang Ten
hybrid_aquatic.sea_message.grapple: A hookshot will get you into the swing of things.
hybrid_aquatic.sea_message.grapple.title: Swingin'
hybrid_aquatic.sea_message.high_seas: Pirate ships chiefly attack on the high seas, preferring dawn or dusk, and especially favoring foul weather.
hybrid_aquatic.sea_message.high_seas.tit: Loathsome Habits of the Scurrilous Pirate
hybrid_aquatic.sea_message.musket: A musket lacks subtlety and panache, but it packs a punch.
hybrid_aquatic.sea_message.musket.title: Bang Bang
hybrid_aquatic.sea_message.nether: Legends say that deep beneath the earth lie portals to the underworld, but an explorer would be hard pressed to find one without directions.
hybrid_aquatic.sea_message.nether.title: Nether You Mind
hybrid_aquatic.sea_message.pirates: The pirates of these islands are number one with a bullet.
hybrid_aquatic.sea_message.pirates.title: It Takes a Pillage
hybrid_aquatic.sea_message.portal: If you want to open a hole between worlds, start where one has been dug before.
hybrid_aquatic.sea_message.portal.title: Weak Spots
hybrid_aquatic.sea_message.sail: Every ship needs a sail. And sometimes sails can be found on ships.
hybrid_aquatic.sea_message.sail.title: Sail Away
hybrid_aquatic.sea_message.slime: If you need slimeballs, the sea can provide.
hybrid_aquatic.sea_message.slime.title: Peanut Butter and WHAT?
hybrid_aquatic.sea_message.tater: Green potatoes are a must if you like your chowder §2§Ispicy§r.
hybrid_aquatic.sea_message.tater.title: Tater Time
hybrid_aquatic.sea_message.towers: In ancient days, someone built towers all across these islands. Those brave enough to scale them may find secrets, and rewards.
hybrid_aquatic.sea_message.towers.title: A Towering Achievment
hybrid_aquatic.sea_message.villagers: The villagers of these islands are suspicious and value their privacy. Snooping around or taking their property may lead to a chilly reception … or worse.
hybrid_aquatic.sea_message.villagers.tit: Welcome to our Island, Now Go Home
hybrid_aquatic.sea_message.shells_boneme: In a pinch, you can roast sea shells for fertilizer.
hybrid_aquatic.sea_message.parrot: They say petting a parrot is good for your heart, and theirs.
hybrid_aquatic.sea_message.parrot.title: Polly Want Affection
hybrid_aquatic.sea_message.grog.title: An Ode To Grog
hybrid_aquatic.sea_message.grog:
They say that grog is like a friend
Who stands with you until the end
An end that comes at a faster jog
The more you drink that rotten grog
hybrid_aquatic.sea_message.mermaid.title: See? Necklace!
hybrid_aquatic.sea_message.mermaid: I ain't never seen a mermaid, but legends speak of a jeweled bauble that grants a measure of their powers.
